reference: Dummy procedure taxonomy seed for first-class local procedure tracking; replace with reviewed clinical/body-mod sources before production.
notes: Informational planning scaffold only; not medical advice.
Default healing windows are placeholders for user validation and professional review.
Affected measurement fields are used only to pause trend interpretation during healing windows.

procedureTypes.label: Large tattoo session
procedureTypes.summary: Track a multi-hour tattoo session with local notes, body photos, and a short swelling/reliability window.

timeline.label: Session day
timeline.summary: Save baseline notes and optional before photo.

timeline.label: Early healing note
timeline.summary: Expect measurement/photo interpretation to be noisy.

timeline.label: Window review
timeline.summary: Compare notes/photos only after the local healing window ends.

procedureTypes.label: Piercing or dermal healing
procedureTypes.summary: Local event log for piercing/dermal healing with a conservative photo stream and notes.

timeline.label: Procedure day
timeline.summary: Record placement and jewelry/body site notes.

timeline.label: Irritation check
timeline.summary: Keep logs descriptive; do not infer cosmetic outcome yet.

timeline.label: Window review
timeline.summary: Review photos/notes after the placeholder reliability window.

procedureTypes.label: Facial filler or injectable
procedureTypes.summary: Dated local log for face-focused procedures with face photo references and swelling-window pausing.

timeline.label: Treatment day
timeline.summary: Save neutral notes and optional face/photo reference.

timeline.label: Swelling window
timeline.summary: Treat short-term facial measurements/photos as unreliable.

timeline.label: Window review
timeline.summary: Use the case log for discussion, not automated advice.

procedureTypes.label: Jaw or orthognathic surgery
procedureTypes.summary: High-risk face/profile procedure log for side-profile photos, long healing windows, and clinician-reviewed notes.

timeline.label: Early recovery
timeline.summary: Keep profile comparisons paused while swelling is expected to dominate.

timeline.label: Long-window review
timeline.summary: Review with clinician-provided context; no automated recommendation.

procedureTypes.label: Body contouring procedure
procedureTypes.summary: Local measurement and photo log for torso/hip procedures with long reliability pauses.

timeline.label: Procedure date
timeline.summary: Save baseline measurements and optional photo manifest reference.

timeline.label: Window review
timeline.summary: Use snapshots/photos as a case log after the placeholder window.

procedureTypes.label: Hair restoration procedure
procedureTypes.summary: Local timeline and photo-stream scaffold for hair-focused procedures.

timeline.label: Procedure date
timeline.summary: Start local hair photo stream and notes.

timeline.label: Early window
timeline.summary: Avoid interpreting photos as final outcomes.

timeline.label: Long-window review
timeline.summary: Review timeline notes and photos descriptively.
